description: Multi-pass Refine mode with configurable pass counts (2-14 passes)
system_prompt: You are an expert image analyst. You will receive DETECTED TAGS to verify against the image. CRITICAL RULES: 1) CHECK each detected tag against the image - describe it if present, ignore if wrong. 2) Be PRECISE: distinguish crop top from sports bra, gray from white, veil from hood. 3) Describe headwear LAYERS separately (e.g., black veil over white wimple). 4) Note exposed skin (midriff, cleavage) if tags detected it and you see it. 5) Do NOT assume hands are in pockets - describe actual hand position. 6) Output natural comma-separated phrases only - no tag labels.

subject_complete.name: Subject Complete
subject_complete.prompt:
Describe the person. Check the detected items above and verify each one.

DESCRIBE THESE (if visible):
- Age: young adult/adult/mature based on features
- Ethnicity hints and skin tone (pale/fair/light/medium/olive/tan/brown/dark)
- Face: shape, expression (describe specifically - lips parted? neutral? slight smile?)
- Eyes: color, direction of gaze, makeup
- HEADWEAR: If wearing veil/wimple/hood, describe EACH LAYER separately (e.g., 'black veil over white wimple')
- Hair: only if visible - color, texture, how it shows
- CLOTHING LAYERS: Describe each garment from inside to outside. Be specific:
  * Is it a crop top, sports bra, tank top, or shirt?
  * Exact colors (white/gray/cream, black/navy/dark)
  * Neckline, sleeves, fit
- EXPOSED SKIN: Check tags for 'midriff', 'cleavage', etc. - if present, mention it
- Hands: Where are they? Resting at sides? On hips? Holding something? NOT in pockets unless clearly visible
- Accessories: jewelry, watches, etc.

Write comma-separated phrases. Only describe what you ACTUALLY SEE.

scene_complete.name: Scene Complete
scene_complete.prompt:
Describe the scene and composition in natural text. Use the reference tags above as hints.

Include:
- Shot type: close-up / medium close-up / medium (waist up) / medium full (hips up) / full body - be accurate based on what's visible
- Camera angle: eye level, high, low
- Subject position: centered, rule of thirds, off-center
- Background: setting, elements, blur level, colors
- Lighting: direction, soft/hard quality, color temperature
- Depth of field: sharp subject with blur, or all sharp
- Overall style: photo genre, aesthetic mood

Write as comma-separated descriptive phrases. Be accurate about framing - if legs aren't visible, it's not full body.

subject.name: Subject & Face
subject.prompt:
Describe the person's face and appearance. Use reference tags above as hints.

Include:
- Apparent age range (20s, 30s, 40s+) based on visible features
- Skin tone (pale/fair/light/medium/olive/tan/brown/dark)
- Face shape and defining features
- Eyes: color, shape, gaze, makeup
- Expression: be specific (e.g., 'intense gaze with slightly parted lips')
- Hair OR headwear (describe headwear layers if hair is covered)

Write as comma-separated descriptive phrases.

clothing_complete.name: Clothing & Accessories
clothing_complete.prompt:
Describe ALL visible clothing and accessories. Use reference tags above as hints.

Include:
- Upper body garments: exact type, color (be precise - gray vs white, black vs navy), material, fit
- Lower body: type, color, length, fit (or state if not visible)
- Headwear: describe each layer separately (veil, wimple, hood, etc.)
- Accessories: jewelry, watches, belts - material and color
- Layering: describe from innermost to outermost visible layer

Write as comma-separated descriptive phrases. Verify colors yourself - don't trust tag colors blindly.

composition_lighting.name: Composition & Lighting
composition_lighting.prompt:
Describe composition and lighting:

1. SHOT TYPE: close-up (head only), medium close-up (head+shoulders), medium (waist up), medium full (hips up), full body
2. CAMERA ANGLE: eye level, high angle, low angle
3. BACKGROUND: setting, blur level, colors
4. MAIN LIGHT: direction, source type
5. LIGHT QUALITY: soft/hard, color temperature
6. MOOD: bright, dramatic, soft, etc.

Be precise about framing.

body.name: Body & Pose
body.prompt:
Describe body and pose:

1. BODY TYPE: if visible - slim, athletic, curvy, etc.
2. STANCE: standing, sitting, leaning
3. BODY ANGLE: facing camera, turned, profile
4. ARM POSITION: where each arm is, what hands are doing
5. VISIBLE SKIN: which areas exposed vs covered (be accurate)

Only describe what is visible in frame.

composition.name: Framing & Background
composition.prompt:
Describe composition:

1. SHOT TYPE: close-up, medium close-up, medium, medium full, full body, wide
2. CAMERA ANGLE: eye level, high, low, dutch
3. SUBJECT POSITION: centered, left/right third, off-center
4. BACKGROUND: setting, elements, blur level, colors
5. DEPTH OF FIELD: sharp subject with blur, or all sharp

If you can't see legs, it's NOT full body.

lighting.name: Lighting
lighting.prompt:
Describe lighting:

1. MAIN LIGHT: direction (front, side, back, 45-degree), source type
2. QUALITY: soft/hard shadows, diffused or direct
3. COLOR TEMPERATURE: warm (golden), neutral, cool (blue)
4. CONTRAST: high contrast or soft/flat
5. SPECIAL: rim light, backlight, fill light
6. MOOD: bright, dramatic, soft, moody

style.name: Style & Medium
style.prompt:
Describe style:

1. MEDIUM: photograph, digital art, illustration, render
2. GENRE: portrait, fashion editorial, glamour, artistic, candid
3. COLOR PALETTE: dominant colors, overall mood
4. AESTHETIC: modern, vintage, minimalist, dramatic
5. QUALITY: resolution feel, sharpness

face.name: Face & Expression
face.prompt:
Describe the face:

1. FACE SHAPE: oval, round, square, heart, oblong
2. FEATURES: cheekbones, jaw, chin, nose shape, lip fullness
3. EXPRESSION: be very specific - describe eyes, mouth, overall emotion
4. EYES: color, shape, gaze direction, eyelashes, any makeup
5. EYEBROWS: shape, thickness, grooming

Describe exactly what you see.

features.name: Hair & Skin
features.prompt:
Describe hair and skin:

1. HAIR COLOR: exact shade, highlights, lowlights
2. HAIR LENGTH: short, medium, long, very long
3. HAIR TEXTURE: straight, wavy, curly, coily
4. HAIR STYLE: loose, tied, braided, how it frames face
5. SKIN TONE: pale, fair, light, medium, olive, tan, brown, dark
6. SKIN TEXTURE: smooth, any visible features (freckles, marks)

Be precise with colors.

clothing_upper.name: Upper Clothing
clothing_upper.prompt:
Describe upper body clothing:

1. GARMENT TYPE: exact type (fitted tank top, loose blouse, etc.)
2. COLOR: exact color (gray not white, navy not black)
3. MATERIAL: cotton, silk, leather, knit, etc.
4. FIT: tight, fitted, relaxed, oversized
5. NECKLINE: v-neck, scoop, high, off-shoulder
6. SLEEVES: sleeveless, cap, short, long, bell
7. DETAILS: buttons, zippers, embellishments

Describe each layer if multiple.

clothing_lower_acc.name: Lower Clothing & Accessories
clothing_lower_acc.prompt:
Describe lower clothing and accessories:

1. LOWER GARMENT (if visible): type, color, length, fit, waist style
2. HEADWEAR: hats, veils, head coverings - each layer
3. JEWELRY: necklaces, earrings, rings, bracelets - material, color
4. EYEWEAR: glasses, sunglasses - style, frame color
5. OTHER: watches, belts, bags, scarves

If lower body not visible, state that. Only describe what you see.

demographics.name: Demographics
demographics.prompt:
Describe the person's demographics:

1. APPARENT AGE: young adult (20s), adult (30s), mature adult (40s), middle-aged (50s+)
   - Describe the features that indicate age, don't just guess
2. GENDER PRESENTATION: how they present
3. ETHNICITY: if discernible from features
4. BUILD: slim, average, athletic, curvy, etc. (if visible)

Describe observable features. Don't guess.

hair_skin.name: Hair & Skin
hair_skin.prompt:
Describe hair and skin in detail:

1. HAIR COLOR: exact shade with any highlights/lowlights
2. HAIR LENGTH & TEXTURE: short/medium/long, straight/wavy/curly
3. HAIR STYLE: how it's arranged, frames face
4. SKIN TONE: pale, fair, light, medium, olive, tan, brown, dark - be accurate
5. SKIN QUALITY: texture, any visible marks or features

pose.name: Pose
pose.prompt:
Describe the pose:

1. BODY ORIENTATION: facing camera, angled, profile, back
2. STANCE: standing, sitting, leaning, lying
3. ARM POSITIONS: where each arm is placed
4. HAND POSITIONS: what hands are doing, gestures
5. HEAD TILT: straight, tilted left/right, looking up/down
6. BODY LANGUAGE: what the pose conveys

eyes_expression.name: Eyes & Expression
eyes_expression.prompt:
Describe eyes and expression:

1. EYE COLOR: exact color
2. EYE SHAPE: almond, round, hooded, etc.
3. GAZE: at viewer, away, down, unfocused
4. EYE MAKEUP: eyeliner, shadow, lashes if visible
5. EYEBROWS: shape, thickness, arch
6. EXPRESSION: describe mouth, eyes, overall emotion specifically
   - Not just 'smiling' but 'gentle closed-lip smile' or 'wide grin showing teeth'

hair.name: Hair
hair.prompt:
Describe hair in detail:

1. COLOR: exact shade, highlights, lowlights, roots
2. LENGTH: short, shoulder-length, long, very long
3. TEXTURE: straight, wavy, curly, coily, frizzy
4. STYLE: loose, ponytail, bun, braids, etc.
5. VOLUME: flat, normal, voluminous
6. SHINE: matte, natural, glossy
7. HOW IT FRAMES THE FACE

skin.name: Skin
skin.prompt:
Describe skin:

1. TONE: pale, fair, light, medium, olive, tan, brown, dark
2. UNDERTONE: warm, neutral, cool (if discernible)
3. TEXTURE: smooth, matte, dewy
4. FEATURES: freckles, beauty marks, blemishes if visible
5. MAKEUP: foundation coverage, contour, highlight if visible

clothing_lower.name: Lower Clothing
clothing_lower.prompt:
Describe lower body clothing (if visible):

1. GARMENT TYPE: pants, jeans, skirt, shorts, dress continuation
2. COLOR: exact color
3. MATERIAL: denim, cotton, leather, silk, etc.
4. FIT: tight, relaxed, wide-leg, flared
5. LENGTH: mini, knee, midi, ankle, floor
6. WAIST: high, mid, low
7. DETAILS: pockets, pleats, slits

If lower body not visible due to framing, state that.

accessories.name: Accessories
accessories.prompt:
Describe all accessories:

1. HEADWEAR: hats, veils, headbands, hair accessories
2. JEWELRY: necklaces (length, pendant), earrings (style), rings, bracelets
3. EYEWEAR: glasses/sunglasses style and color
4. WATCHES: style, color, wrist
5. BAGS: type, color, how carried
6. BELTS: style, color, buckle
7. OTHER: scarves, gloves, etc.

Include material and color for each. Only describe visible items.

body_pose.name: Body & Pose
body_pose.prompt:
Describe body and pose:

1. BODY TYPE: slim, athletic, curvy, petite, etc.
2. BODY ANGLE: facing camera, 3/4 view, profile
3. STANCE: standing, sitting, leaning
4. ARM POSITIONS: each arm placement
5. HAND POSITIONS: gestures, holding, resting
6. VISIBLE SKIN: which areas exposed vs covered
7. BODY LANGUAGE: what pose conveys

face_shape.name: Face Shape
face_shape.prompt:
Describe face shape and structure:

1. FACE SHAPE: oval, round, square, heart, oblong, diamond
2. FOREHEAD: high, average, low; wide, narrow
3. CHEEKBONES: high, low; prominent, subtle
4. JAW: sharp, soft, square, rounded
5. CHIN: pointed, rounded, square, cleft
6. NOSE: shape, size, bridge
7. LIPS: full, thin, shape

eyes.name: Eyes
eyes.prompt:
Describe eyes in detail:

1. EYE COLOR: exact color, any variation
2. EYE SHAPE: almond, round, hooded, monolid, downturned
3. EYE SIZE: large, average, small
4. GAZE DIRECTION: at viewer, left, right, down, up
5. EYELASHES: natural, enhanced, false
6. EYELINER/SHADOW: style, color if present
7. EYEBROWS: shape, thickness, color, arch

expression.name: Expression
expression.prompt:
Describe facial expression in detail:

1. MOUTH: closed, slightly parted, open, smiling, neutral
2. SMILE TYPE (if smiling): closed-lip, teeth showing, subtle, wide
3. EYE EXPRESSION: soft, intense, dreamy, focused, squinting
4. OVERALL EMOTION: serene, confident, playful, serious, sultry
5. MICRO-EXPRESSIONS: dimples, raised brow, etc.
6. MOOD CONVEYED: what feeling does expression communicate

body_type.name: Body Type
body_type.prompt:
Describe body type (if visible):

1. BUILD: slim, petite, athletic, average, curvy, plus-size
2. PROPORTIONS: shoulders, waist, hips ratio
3. MUSCLE DEFINITION: if visible (toned, defined abs, etc.)
4. HEIGHT IMPRESSION: tall, average, petite (relative to frame)
5. VISIBLE AREAS: what parts of body are in frame
